name: facial-roller
description: A facial roller with a rounded cylinder, two side supports and a long handle.
useCase: Identify facial rollers or handheld skincare massage tools.
misuse: Use a visible label when a tool identifies a product or a specific grooming task.

16.reason: The rounded cylinder remains open above two curved supports and a longer grip.

24.reason: Both supports meet the roller ends and flow into the centered handle, keeping the roller separate from the grip.
